units.source_text: 战乱和不安，累累的死尸和大量的血，丰富了金阁的美，这是自然的。

en.t: War and unrest, heaps of corpses and great quantities of blood, enriched the beauty of the Golden Pavilion; that was only natural.

units.source_text: 因为金阁本来就是由不安建成的建筑物，是以一名将军为中心、众多黑暗心灵的所有者筹建的建筑物。

en.t: For the Golden Pavilion was, from the beginning, a building constructed out of unrest, a building planned around one shogun by many people possessed of dark hearts.

units.source_text: 美术史家在那里只看见样式的折衷，其三层的零乱的设计，无疑是探索一种使不安结晶的模式，自然形成如此的模样。

en.t: Art historians see there only an eclectic mixture of styles, but the disorderly design of its three stories was undoubtedly the natural form taken by a search for a pattern that would crystallize unrest.

units.source_text: 要是用一种安定的模式的话，那么金阁就不可能承受那种不安而早已崩溃，这是毫无疑问的。

en.t: If a stable pattern had been used, the Golden Pavilion could not have endured that unrest and would long since have collapsed; there is no doubt of that.
